plan_area_inventory.title: Cursor, Pi, and OpenCode share maximum-autonomy continue policy
Errors and its-magic flow faults self-resolve
Clear sequence continues when the outcome differs from the expected result

decomposition.why_not_split: INTAKE_GUIDED_MODE=0. One operator outcome: the whole its-magic concept on Cursor, Pi, and OpenCode is checked and shaped so maximum autonomy is possible, clear sequences stay, and mismatch, error, flow fault, and missing workflow rights do not halt the run.

duplicate_check.rationale: US-0160 (OPEN) is the OpenCode plus itsm TUI slice: recoverable blocker, error, abort, permission, and faulty-state continues, and the TUI shows the latest diagnostic once plus the ask result. This request is the whole-concept check across Cursor, Pi, and OpenCode, plus the rule that a clear phase sequence does not block when the outcome does not match expectations. US-0158 (OPEN) only repairs a phase child's own invalid continuation pair. US-0092, US-0095, and US-0156 stay DONE.

non_goals.us0092_ac10: Do not authorize reading .env or automatic npm publish / git push. Those stay US-0092 AC-10. Recorded as a non-goal and a discovery risk, not as a decision_gate.
non_goals.honest_results: UNKNOWN_COMMAND for free text and APP_HEALTH_UNAVAILABLE when no app process is running stay honest results. They are not expectation-mismatch repairs.

bug_routing_guard.note: Exit 0 does not allocate a BUG id. US-0161 allocated after the guard. Prose avoids the defect-signal words.
